# Feature-readiness register (generated)

**Do not edit this file.** It is rendered from the declarations in `docs/readiness/*.yml` by `python -m braunschweig.readiness render`.

Each column reports whether a declared pointer RESOLVES, not whether the feature is scientifically good: ✅ resolved, ⚠️ unproven or stale, ❌ contradicted by the repository, — not applicable. A ✅ in *Reference* means the reference file is committed, not that the model matches it; the realised fit lives in the KPI column and comes from a run.

Coverage: 58/58 active rows of the `PROJECT_STATUS.md` feature matrix are declared.
